loop.top3_why_not: Strategy B, while more stable across windows, has a higher overall error and relies on inverse‑error weighting that may over‑emphasise the noisy ranking in this short validation set. Strategy C uses a plain mean, which is less adaptive to the trend‑dominated nature of the series and yields a higher overall error. Given the risk of over‑fitting with only three windows, the meta‑model weighting of A strikes the best balance between performance and robustness.
